title: Masters Edition IV: card flavor text

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer and brother of Mishra who discovered the Mightstone and fought Mishra.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother, who discovered the weakstone and came to despise Tocasia.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: The brothers' original master, who made Onulets and taught clarity of purpose.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's greatest assistant, promoted to master after creating clay warriors.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: An artificer who created staves for Zegon's defense.

entities.name: Zegon
entities.description: A figure whose defense Ashnod's staves served.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: A Soldevi machinist.

entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Leader of the Knights of Stromgald.

entities.name: Irini Sengir
entities.description: A speaker who curses Reveka and her conjurers.

entities.name: Reveka
entities.description: A person with a school of sorcerers that Irini Sengir covets.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer
entities.description: A necromancer who praises minions given to Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A demonic figure whose minions are strengthened.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An angel whose spirit survives as long as the Homelands do, though long dead.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: A figure long since dead like Serra.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: A speaker to Daria about Serra's spirit.

entities.name: Daria
entities.description: The person Taysir addresses about Serra and the Homelands.

entities.name: Arna Kennerud
entities.description: A skycaptain of the Karplusans.

entities.name: Captain Soll
entities.description: A captain asked what became of the Serafina.

entities.name: Al-abara
entities.description: A woman who laughed and flew away on a carpet.

entities.name: Baki
entities.description: A wizard attendant on the Floating Isle.

entities.name: Sevti Mukul
entities.description: Author of The Fall of Alsoor.

entities.name: Chandler
entities.description: A speaker eyeing an ebony rhino for profit.

entities.name: Joven
entities.description: The person Chandler addresses.

entities.name: Nireya
entities.description: A person who reached through a Planar Gate.

entities.name: Sarsour
entities.description: A man pelted and misdirected by a sandstorm.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: The diarist who entered Phyrexia.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: A Samite alchemist.

entities.name: Vervamon the Elder
entities.description: A scholar who says it is fitting to die in pursuit of knowledge.

entities.name: Gwendlyn Di Corci
entities.description: A speaker on making people wait.

entities.name: Aline Corralurn
entities.description: Author of Inheritance.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: A realm where grease rains.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane written Dominia that was made a casualty of the war between the brothers.

entities.name: Kroog
entities.description: A city of healers that Urza befriended and that Mishra's forces destroyed.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A sacred cave the brothers and Tocasia explored.

entities.name: Hall of Tagsin
entities.description: A hall in Koilos where the Mightstone and weakstone were found.

entities.name: Sardia
entities.description: The land where the Colossus buried as Mount Sardia was known.

entities.name: Knights of Stromgald
entities.description: A band led by Avram Garrisson.

entities.name: Soldevi
entities.description: A people whose machinists include Arcum Dagsson.

entities.name: Alaborn
entities.description: A people with muskets, troopers and a King.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: A remarkable stone Urza found in the Hall of Tagsin.

entities.name: Weakstone
entities.description: A mysterious stone Mishra found in the Hall of Tagsin.

entities.name: Battle of Tomakul
entities.description: A battle that taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

events.summary: Urza discovers the Mightstone in the Hall of Tagsin while exploring Koilos with Mishra and Tocasia.
events.quote: Urza fell behind in the Hall of Tagsin, where he discovered the remarkable Mightstone.

events.summary: Mishra discovers the weakstone in the Hall of Tagsin during the brothers' childhood.
Urza gives potent amulets to the healers of Kroog, and thousands journey there for healing.
events.quote: Urza gave the healers of the city potent amulets

events.summary: Tawnos creates clay warriors and Urza promotes him from apprentice to master.
events.quote: Urza ended his apprenticeship, promoting him directly to the rank of master.

events.summary: Kroog is destroyed while most of its defenders are at Urza's side, and Urza vows his allies will never fear for their defense.
events.quote: Urza vowed that none of his allies would ever need to fear for their own defense again

events.summary: Mishra's forces use war machines to take Kroog.
events.quote: Those who believed the city of Kroog would never fall to Mishra's forces severely underestimated the might of his war machines.

events.summary: The war between Urza and Mishra makes Dominia itself a casualty of war.
events.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra made Dominia itself a casualty of war
Though he eventually came to despise Tocasia

events.summary: A sandstorm pelts Sarsour and rearranges itself so he cannot find his way.
events.quote: Even the landscape turned against Sarsour

events.summary: Al-abara laughs and lifts a finger, and her carpet carries her out of reach.
events.quote: Al-abara simply laughed and lifted one finger

events.summary: Urza learns from the Battle of Tomakul not to rely on fickle reinforcements.
events.quote: The Battle of Tomakul taught Urza not to rely on fickle reinforcements.

relations.note: They wage war against each other.
relations.quote: the war between Urza and Mishra

relations.note: Leader of the Knights of Stromgald.
relations.quote: Leader of the Knights of Stromgald

relations.note: Irini curses Reveka and her conjurers.
relations.quote: Curse Reveka, and curse her coddled conjurers.
